text:
As for my explanation.

This lacerates me with earlyness.

That way of walking along trapezes.

Those courageous brutes, like false additions.

That gum gluing quicksilver to the inside.

Those buttocks seated upward.

That cannot be, been.

Absurd.

Dementia.

But I have come from Trujillo to Lima.

But I earn a salary of five soles.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem XIV — As for My Explanation
translation.editorial_note: Tempranía becomes earlyness and the impossible tense of sido remains exposed; the final salary keeps its blunt socioeconomic descent.
